name: Forno Acqua Premium A White Luxurious Super Smart Toilet
shortDescription: FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet – Intelligent Design, Everyday Simplicity. Elevate your bathroom with the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet, a modern tankless skirted toilet that delivers smart functionality and minimalist style—without the added cost of a bideet nor a heated seat. Ideal for powder rooms, guest baths and secondary bathrooms, Auto-sensing lid, seat, and flush plus Foot sensor for total touchless operation. Certified to MaP’s highest performance standards, the Auto Dual Flush system delivers powerful, clog-free performance. Integrated deodorizer for a fresher bathroom environment. Sleek tankless, skirted design for easy cleaning and a minimalist look. Whether you're remodeling or building new, the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet offers a cleaner, more comfortable lifestyle—without the complexity of a bidet or heated seat. Smart. Simple. Stylish. Experience FORNO ACQUA.

features.text: Premium A Smart Toilet w/ Auto Flush
Built-In Bidet – Adjustable spray strength, water temperature, nozzle position and massage functions (pulsate & oscillate) for personalized hygiene & comfort
High-Performance Flush – AcquaPOWER technology delivers best-in-class 1000g MaP performance for a quiet, powerful, clog-free waste removal
Heated Seat – Enjoy soothing warmth with 4 adjustable temperature settings for personalized comfort year-round
Touchless Walk-Away Flush – AcquaSMART triggers a smart dual flush when you step away or tap the foot sensor. Hands-free, hygienic, and effortless
AcquaSMART Advanced Technology - automatic lid open & close, foot sensor seat open & close and lid close for seamless, hands-free convenience
Smart Dual Flush – Automatically adjusts flush volume based on usage to maximize water efficiency
